entities.summary: Dieudonné Nzapalainga, CSSp is a Central African prelate of the Catholic Church who has been the Archbishop of Bangui since 2012, where he served as apostolic administrator from 2009 to 2012. He has been president of the Central African Episcopal Conference since 2013. He is a member of the Spiritans. Dieudonné Nzapalainga was a religious figures from Mbomou Prefecture (b. 1967-03-14, Mbomou Prefecture). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
